scope: Arham Tahir's independent QQ16 reverse-covector audit of ywz65's PR2628 error contract. Reviewed all 2680 initialized changed-field boundaries, five metrics on 464 final fields, signed owner-map composition and the exact feedback inequality. Registered replay corroborates the 841 interior witness and proves a 20-bit sufficient uniform guard for this inequality. This does not establish that 19 bits must fail physically, native rounding accuracy, entry/B1 bounds, exact borrowed restoration or supplier admission.
